name: v0.1.0
body:
To use, add this to your `MODULE.bazel` file:

```starlark
bazel_dep(name = "rules_elisp", version = "0.1.0")
```


## What's Changed
* Add BazelCI configuration by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2001
* Replace default_applicable_licenses with default_package_metadata by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2003
* Factor out useful CI configuration into .bazelrc by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2005
* Rename bazel-test.yaml to just test.yaml by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2004
* Update bazel-contrib/publish-to-bcr action to v1.5.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2008
* Update module golang.org/x/text to v0.41.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2007
* Update module google.golang.org/protobuf to v1.36.12 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2006
* Revert "Try to unbreak build on Windows with rules_go 0.61.0" by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2010
* Update module github.com/bazelbuild/rules_go to v0.63.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2009
* Work around Gazelle v2 issues by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2012
* Update rules_go to v0.63.0 by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2011
* Update github.com/bazel-contrib/bazel-gazelle/v2 digest to 2a34c89 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2013
* Prefer use_cc_toolchain.bzl over find_cc_toolchain.bzl by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2016
* Use launcher machinery to run local Emacsen by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2015
* Add missing #include by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2014
* Update github.com/bazel-contrib/bazel-gazelle/v2 digest to b9fe795 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2018
* Also run tests with locally-installed Emacs by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/515
* Revert "Specify host fragments in addition to target fragments" by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2020
* Don’t fail too early if EMACS is set to an empty string by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2017
* Add back magic ‘indirect’ comment by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2021
* Factor our common launcher rule setup into a helper function by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2022
* Use new tag for Gazelle v2 by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2023
* Update Gazelle to v0.53.0 by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2026
* Update module github.com/bazelbuild/bazel-gazelle to v0.53.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2025
* Update github.com/bazelbuild/buildtools digest to 5d08cfd by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2024
* Run go mod tidy by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2027
* Update github.com/bazelbuild/buildtools digest to 674b293 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2028
* Add toolchains for Emacs 31 by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2029
* Update support status by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2030
* Remove Emacs 29 toolchains by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2031
* Make Emacs 31 the default Emacs by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2032
* Revert "Work around https://debbugs.gnu.org/cgi/bugreport.cgi?bug=76441" by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/2035


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/compare/v0.0.9...v0.1.0

name: v0.0.3
body:
## What's Changed
* Add target to create a release by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1982
* Add Bazel Central Registry configuration by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1983
* Revert "Support building with GCC on macOS" by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1986
* Simplify invocation using --run_in_cwd by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1978
* Add “Publish to BCR” workflow by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1984
* Revert "Fix build breakage" by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1985
* Don’t rename repository for addlicense by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1987
* Revert "Refine setting the “CC” environment variable" by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1989
* Quote Bazel version strings by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1992
* Match MODULE.bazel filename by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1990
* Factor out shared C/C++ compiler setup by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1993
* Use empty string instead of ‘default’ by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1994
* Re-enable coverage on macOS by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1997
* Simplify a few conditional expressions by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1996
* Use a nicer cache key for the default Bazel version by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1995
* Comment out non-default .bazelrc lines by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1998
* Simplify ternary conditionals using ‘case’ function by @phst in https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/pull/1999


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/phst/rules_elisp/compare/v0.0.2...v0.0.3
